Change. Just hearing that word can make our shoulders tense up, right? Especially when the goals we set feel a little too big... and our willpower seems to disappear just when we need it most. But what if it didn’t have to be so hard? What if your journey to real, lasting change could actually feel manageable—maybe even enjoyable?
That’s exactly what we’ll explore together, inspired by Stephen Guise’s book, Mini Habits: Smaller Habits, Bigger Results. Here, we’re invited to look at personal growth in a whole new way—one where those tiny, almost laughably easy steps you take each day add up to something truly powerful. Instead of chasing bursts of motivation or making huge, unsustainable resolutions, we’ll learn how building momentum with simple, consistent actions can make all the difference. In this approach, change isn’t about dramatic overhauls. It’s about gentle, steady shifts—where even your smallest wins spark a sense of accomplishment and trust in yourself. The beauty of mini habits is that they work even when you’re busy, tired, or not feeling your best. You’ll see how lowering the bar just enough actually helps you move forward, no matter what kind of day you’re having. So, as we step into this journey together, let’s get curious. What could happen if you allowed yourself to start small... and just kept going? You might be surprised at how the tiniest actions can lead to the biggest results.
